newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE sentences Indian woman to death for murder.
newsitem.headline: UAE sentences Indian woman to death for murder.

text.p: A United Arab Emirates court has sentenced a 23-year-old Indian woman to death for murdering her 70-year-old husband, a UAE national, newspapers reported on Thursday.
They said a court in the emirate of Ras al-Khaimah passed the death sentence on the Indian woman after finding her guilty of stabbing her husband to death in June last year.
The woman confessed to police to murdering her husband because he refused to give her her passport to travel home to see her family in India, newspapers said.
The UAE has enforced the death sentence for crimes such as rape, murder and drug smuggling.
